title: perf(console): an object list and a record page no longer load the Studio designer's string table on first paint
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2qzrpapiEtaSS8VNGQmWkU)_

Part of #37444. This is slice C of that card: route-level JS an object list and a record page load before first paint that they do not need. The card stays open: the production re-measure (card comment 7193730951) shows no single seam brings the three pages under 2.5 s, and the other slices (eager-closure diet, boot waterfall, render CPU) are filed by the seat as their own cards.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：所有用户打开对象列表页和记录页时，少下载约 94 KB 用不到的 Studio 设计器文字；页面内容和保存行为都不变。
- 为什么做：属于「首屏加载 2.5 秒」这张卡拆出的第一刀（C）。记录页首屏中位数从 4223 降到 4066 毫秒，列表页和首页的变化在测量误差内。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是设计器打开时某段文字显示慢一拍，或某个保存入口找不到辅助函数而报错；改动只是搬家加转出口，可以整笔撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Two component modules in `@object-ui/app-shell` held small pure helpers next to React components that import the designer's `t()` (`views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) and, through it, the `studio` namespace's English catalogue (`@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/studio`, its own 69 KB gzipped chunk). The running app's save paths that load with a list or record page import those helpers, so the static import pulled the whole designer table, the Studio header and the Customize controls into both pages' first load.

- `views/studio-design/customizeOverride.ts` (new): the Customize door's pure half, moved verbatim out of `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` (`STUDIO_CUSTOMIZE_TYPES`, `isStudioCustomizeType`, `declaredOverrideOf`, `overrideDraftBody`, `customizeDoorWalled`, `useCustomizeDoorWalled`, `OBJECT_EXTENSION_TYPE`, `extensionFieldName`, `objectExtensionBodyOf`, `ObjectExtensionBody`).
- `views/metadata-admin/draftVersionGuard.ts` (new): the draft-version guard's pure half, moved verbatim out of `DraftConflictDialog.tsx` (the conflict predicates, the pins, `readDraftForSave`, `DraftVersionGuard`, `heldDraftVersionOf` and their types). `useDraftSaveGuard` and the dialog, which render and translate, stay where they were.
- Both old modules re-export every moved name, so every other importer (the designer's pillars, inspectors and editors) is unchanged.
- The runtime importers now read the new modules: `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, `recordTabsConfigSave.ts`, `objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts`, `RecordTabsConfig.tsx`, `ReportView.tsx`, `DashboardView.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx`, `setup/publicForms.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `metadata-admin/detailSaveAtOnce.ts`, `layout/designModeMenuSave.ts`, `layout/designModeHeaderPinsSave.ts`. Three tests that mocked `useCustomizeDoorWalled` on `StudioCustomizeControls` now mock it on `customizeOverride`, where the hook lives.

No behaviour, string, route or saved document changes. Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@objectstack/console` (the Console dist ships the change).

## Tests

- New `views/__tests__/firstScreenStudioCatalogue-37444.test.ts`: walks each first-screen save path's static relative imports in source (type-only imports and `import()` excluded) and asserts none reaches the designer string table; the walk proves it sees the edge by requiring `DraftConflictDialog.tsx` and `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` to reach it, and the two new modules import no component module. Ablation: pointing `recordTabsConfigSave.ts` back at `DraftConflictDialog.js` reds `views/recordTabsConfigSave.ts reaches no designer string table through static imports` (1 failed, 5 passed); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` tests touching any moved name or edited importer: 85 files, 977 tests passed (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the 85 files, from `ui/`); the new file 6/6.
- `tsc --noEmit` in `ui/packages/app-shell` exit 0; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0.
- `eslint` over the 20 changed `ui/` files: 0 errors (181 warnings, all `react-refresh/only-export-components` of the kind these files already carried).

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured effect (production build, the card's conditions)** — tree: this branch (`688b77ff` source; Console rebuilt with `pnpm console:build`), `objectstack start` with `NODE_ENV=production`, Lighthouse 13.6.0 desktop preset, Chrome for Testing 158 headless, 4-core container, 5 runs per page, every run on the requested page, signed in, cold cache:

  | Page | Before (main `021524cd`) | After (this branch) |
  |:--|--:|--:|
  | Home | 3626 (3639, 3626, 3538, 3509, 3685) | 3669 (3688, 3643, 3735, 3669, 3662) |
  | Object list | 4611 (4595, 4611, 4483, 4664, 4771) | 4644 (4563, 4784, 4644, 4508, 4651) |
  | Record page | 4223 (4223, 4238, 4285, 4168, 4188) | 4066 (4201, 4187, 4042, 4066, 4051) |

  Script bytes before LCP: list 2443 → 2349 KB, record 2340 → 2246 KB, home unchanged (1976 KB). The record page gains 157 ms; the list page's bytes drop by the same 94 KB but its LCP does not move, because its critical path is the serial API chain that the chunk loaded beside; home does not load these chunks. All three pages still miss 2500 ms, as the card's reading predicted for any single slice.
- Static route closures read off the built Console (`ObjectView` / `RecordDetailView`, non-eager chunks reachable by static import): 441 → 347 KB and 347 → 254 KB gzipped. The eager closure is unchanged (1,991,173 → 1,991,266 bytes gzipped; `check:eager-closure` reads it in CI).
- The record page's other large route chunk, `plugin-grid` (192 KB gzipped), was looked at and left: rolldown groups `plugin-detail` (the record page's own renderer: `DetailView`, `RelatedList`, the activity timeline) into it, so it is the page's own code, not a stray. Splitting `ImportWizard` / bulk-action code out of it is a possible later cut inside the eager/route diet slices.
- `layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` also now reads the new modules, but still reaches the designer table through the app-nav canvas it imports; it loads with design mode, not with a list or record page, so the pin does not list it.
- L2 owed (not self-reviewed): a contract-tier read is not needed (no governed path; no spec, no protocol change); the seat's L1 reads the CI check-runs.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/firstScreenStudioCatalogue-37444.test.ts` → 6 passed. In a built Console, the `RecordDetailView-*.js` and `ObjectView-*.js` chunks no longer import `i18n-ns-studio-en-*.js` through any static chain.

Read first: `views/metadata-admin/draftVersionGuard.ts` (the guard class moved verbatim; check no symbol was left behind that `useDraftSaveGuard` needs), `views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` (the re-export block and the trimmed imports), the three test mocks retargeted to `customizeOverride`.
